commit_message: Move managed resource integrity checks into workers
pr_title: Fix Managed Local AI resource worker boundaries
pr_body:
## Summary

- enforce ADR 0155 frozen Managed Local integrity inside the existing model-resource worker before Release/Reload operations
- carry one frozen Managed Local resource config through Managed Play capability planning and transition startup to avoid duplicate resolution
- keep Resume/reload integrity work off the Editor frame thread and cover WindowsNative/Wsl2 worker behavior with regression tests

## Scope

This change is intentionally stacked on the repaired Draft PR #909 HEAD so it reuses that in-flight frozen-config/inference-worker boundary instead of duplicating the separate Send, GPU-layer, inference-error, or benchmark-campaign fixes.

No presentation/layout behavior changes; Visual Validation is not requested.
